headline: Apple reportedly partners with LG on new smart home device lineup
summary: Apple is reportedly working with LG, per a Bloomberg report, on a lineup of LG-branded smart home devices including a lock, doorbell and thermostat that would integrate with Apple's rumored smart home hub. Reports differ slightly on the device list, with a later report naming a temperature sensor rather than a camera.
